package calc

import (
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func TestSum(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		in   []int
		want int
	}{
		{"empty", nil, 0},
		{"single", []int{5}, 5},
		{"positives", []int{1, 2, 3}, 6},
		{"negatives", []int{-1, -2}, -3},
		{"mixed", []int{10, -4, 1}, 7},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if got := Sum(tc.in); got != tc.want {
				t.Fatalf("Sum(%v) = %d, want %d", tc.in, got, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestDedupe(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		in   []int
		want []int
	}{
		{"empty", nil, []int{}},
		{"no_duplicates", []int{1, 2, 3}, []int{1, 2, 3}},
		{"adjacent", []int{1, 1, 2}, []int{1, 2}},
		{"scattered", []int{1, 2, 1, 3, 2}, []int{1, 2, 3}},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if got := Dedupe(tc.in); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, tc.want) {
				t.Fatalf("Dedupe(%v) = %v, want %v", tc.in, got, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestWindow(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		in   []int
		size int
		want [][]int
	}{
		{"pairs", []int{1, 2, 3}, 2, [][]int{{1, 2}, {2, 3}}},
		{"full_span", []int{1, 2, 3}, 3, [][]int{{1, 2, 3}}},
		{"too_large", []int{1, 2}, 3, nil},
		{"zero_size", []int{1, 2}, 0, nil},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if got := Window(tc.in, tc.size); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, tc.want) {
				t.Fatalf("Window(%v, %d) = %v, want %v", tc.in, tc.size, got, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
